title: Rosogolla
summary: Rosogolla is a Bengali sweet of soft chhena (fresh cheese) balls cooked in light sugar syrup. Bengal received a GI tag for 'Banglar Rasogolla' in 2017.
steps: Curdle boiled milk with lemon juice; strain and rinse the chhena
Knead the chhena until smooth and roll into small crack-free balls
Boil in thin sugar syrup, covered, for about 15–20 minutes until they swell
